direction:
Medium close-up of Bram, the lamplighter (charcoal flat cap, thick handlebar moustache, cream knitted scarf, deep-red wool coat), standing by a lamplit doorway at night. He is talking to Pip, a small child just out of frame to the right.
Bram says one line, sarcastically: "Oh, that's just great."
Sarcastic acting: heavy-lidded eyes, a beat of stillness, an eye-roll just before the last word, a lopsided smirk, and a small flat hand gesture on "great".
One continuous shot, fixed camera, no cuts. Only Bram speaks; no music and no other dialogue.
about: Draft tier: MiniMax H3 Max on fal, 2026-11-01, 5 s at 768P, prompt expansion disabled, two takes per condition, every take shown. All conditions open on the same frame of Bram except “expressive reference”, which opens on a variant derived from it, so identity isn't the variable. Opening frames: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst from a lab render. Voice: ElevenLabs v4 (George). Transcripts: ElevenLabs Scribe v2. The image-to-video and reference-to-video endpoints differ, so this is a workflow comparison, not a controlled benchmark.
reviewStatus: Draft notes: written by Claude on 2026-11-01 from frames every 0.6 s, full-size spot checks, Scribe transcripts with word timings, and an envelope correlation against the cast voice take. I can't listen to audio, so voice quality and delivery still need a human ear. Awaiting editor approval.
summary: Only the pinned voice gave the exact delivery and timing that was cast; the gestures then drifted off the words.
Acting references put the gesture on “great” and toward Pip, but the voice was re-synthesized and the timing stretched.
An expression image sets the opening face; the model doesn't keep it.
Prompt alone: the model chooses the voice, the timing and even background music.
